title: LT Verdict source-request.v3
description: Backend additionally checks margin_ms divisible by step_ms, max_idle_gap_ms at least step_ms and divisible by step_ms, end > start, whole cells ((end - start) divisible by step), 1..100000 cells, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes and no ISO control characters per profile identifier, and request file at most 16 KiB. Identifiers are sorted during parsing; the document may list them unsorted. An auto window is derived at acquisition time from the run-period.v1 artifact recognized from the same load bytes; the derivation is refused with AUTO_WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE, AUTO_WINDOW_MULTI_TEST_SUSPECTED or AUTO_WINDOW_SPAN_UNSUPPORTED before any external request, and a refusal requires an explicit window.
